Overview

Palm Bay is a city in FL with a population of 115,000. Space Coast city on the Indian River Lagoon with affordable housing and outdoor recreation. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
